description: Shared wording for clarification questions in the cleaned observation layer.

interpretation.empty_flags: No clarification questions were generated; this does not mean the record was verified.
interpretation.resolved_location: The stated location scope has a selected interpretation; verification is recorded separately.
interpretation.resolved_question: The clarification question was addressed; this does not certify the entire record.
interpretation.attribution: Inclusion, office associations and flags do not establish who proposed, inserted, endorsed or was responsible for a budget item.

location_unclear.label: Location needs clarification
location_unclear.description: The evidence does not identify a locality at a useful level for the stated task.
location_unclear.requested_information: Provide the intended province, city or municipality, barangay, or project coordinates.
location_unclear.trigger_guidance: Use for a material location gap. Missing coordinates alone are insufficient when other evidence establishes a useful locality.

location_alternatives.label: Several locations are possible
location_alternatives.description: Competing interpretations remain for the same location claim.
location_alternatives.requested_information: Identify the intended location, or confirm that the project covers several locations.
location_alternatives.trigger_guidance: Use for competing supported interpretations, not every national name match or a valid project covering several places.

location_conflict.label: Location details disagree
location_conflict.description: Retained evidence indicates incompatible places for the same location claim.
location_conflict.requested_information: Confirm the project locality and clarify which title, coordinate or other source detail describes it.
location_conflict.trigger_guidance: Compare evidence for the same claim and scope. A DEO name association or a score penalty alone does not establish a project-site conflict.

project_coverage_unclear.label: Project coverage needs clarification
project_coverage_unclear.description: A known point or locality does not establish the coverage needed for the stated task.
project_coverage_unclear.requested_information: Provide endpoints, alignment, covered barangays or a site plan, as applicable.
project_coverage_unclear.trigger_guidance: Use when incomplete coverage materially limits interpretation. Do not flag every point-based record merely because full project extent is unassessed.

description_unclear.label: Project description needs clarification
description_unclear.description: Wording, truncation or extraction uncertainty materially affects project identification.
description_unclear.requested_information: Provide the intended project description or a supporting source document.
description_unclear.trigger_guidance: Use for a documented identification gap. Readability cleanup, an unfamiliar name or a technical parser warning alone is insufficient.

record_relationship_unclear.label: Record relationship needs clarification
record_relationship_unclear.description: Retained comparison evidence leaves uncertainty about whether records describe the same project, separate phases or separate works.
record_relationship_unclear.requested_information: Clarify the relationship between the referenced records and provide supporting documentation if available.
record_relationship_unclear.trigger_guidance: Reference the related records and the specific matching uncertainty. House-only, NEP-only and not-compared membership alone do not establish a problem.

open.label: Awaiting clarification
open.description: A clarification question remains open; this does not mean a request has been sent.

response_received.label: Response received
response_received.description: A response has been recorded and awaits assessment.

under_review.label: Clarification under review
under_review.description: A recorded review is in progress; no correction is implied.

resolved.label: Clarification completed
resolved.description: A recorded assessment explains how the question was addressed.

closed_no_change.label: Review closed without a data change
closed_no_change.description: A recorded assessment closes the review without changing the data; remaining uncertainty is retained.

resolved.label: Location interpretation selected
resolved.description: A location interpretation is selected for the declared scope; it may remain provisional.

partially_resolved.label: Location partly identified
partially_resolved.description: Some useful administrative levels or parts of the declared scope are identified; the remaining gap is explicit.

ambiguous.label: Competing location interpretations
ambiguous.description: Competing interpretations remain for the declared scope; no single interpretation resolves them.

unresolved.label: Location not identified
unresolved.description: No location interpretation has been selected for the declared scope.

not_applicable.label: Project-site location not applicable
not_applicable.description: A project-site location is not applicable to this record's declared kind and scope.
